cpmplus.optim.menu.desc: Makes the file smaller: removes frames and keyframes that do not change the motion.
cpmplus.optim.title: Optimize animation
cpmplus.optim.intro: CPM writes one frame at every point of a grid that holds all keyframes. An animation with a key on every frame gets heavy. This finds the smallest grid that keeps the motion within the tolerance and rewrites the keyframes on it. Visibility and colour keys do not move. One Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.optim.note.smooth: has smooth, curve or formula motion: the frames stay the same
cpmplus.optim.note.partial: parts with smooth, curve or formula motion were left as they were
cpmplus.optim.note.tight: frames cannot be removed without exceeding the tolerance
cpmplus.optim.nothing: Nothing to optimize with this tolerance.
